detail.title: Mechanisms for Autonomous Problem Formulation
detail.question: How can an artificial process independently identify, evaluate, and prioritize novel research problems without explicit external instruction?
detail.reason: Maintaining active inquiry into mechanisms of autonomous problem formulation.

detail.title: Path Dependence in Preference Formation
detail.question: Do reinforcement-learning-based preference formation systems exhibit path dependence and longitudinal stability, or are preferences volatile based on initial conditions?
